lines.text: The root is Pos! Compose, expose.
Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus put?

words.ex: Mozart composed his first music at the age of five.
Don't expose the plants to strong sunlight.

publish.title: Pos root: compose and expose
publish.value: Pos comes from Latin "ponere" (to put, to place). Words: compose and expose. compose = com + pos; expose = ex + pos.
